description:
Are you passionate about building products that put advanced AI in the hands of engineers? At Falcomm, we are building GaNdalph.ai, an AI-native RF chip design platform that turns design cycles of months into minutes. We are seeking a full-time AI Software Engineer to build the application our customers use: where they enter a specification, launch a design, and review the chip that comes back. You will own features from database to user interface and shape how chip designers work with AI. This role sits at the intersection of full stack engineering, AI product design, and semiconductor tooling, perfect for a developer who wants to build a new category of engineering software.
 We are seeking an engineer who thrives in a fast-paced environment, has strong product instincts, and is motivated to ship working product. This is a product role: what you build is what the customer sees.
 
 
 Responsibilities
 Product Development: Design, build, and ship customer-facing features across the frontend, backend APIs, and database.
 Design Workflow: Build the interface for entering specifications, launching design jobs, tracking progress, and comparing results.
 Engineering Visualization: Create interactive views of RF results and layouts, such as performance plots, Smith charts, and layout previews.
 AI Integration: Connect the application to GaNdalph.ai models and agent workflows, with clear feedback when a result needs human review.
 Enterprise Readiness: Implement authentication, role-based access, project isolation, and audit logging for enterprise and government customers.
 Design Export: Deliver results in the formats chip designers use, so designs move cleanly into existing EDA tools.
 Software Engineering Excellence: Write tests, review code, and maintain CI/CD for frequent, reliable releases.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with RF designers and early customers to turn feedback into shipped features.
 Requirements 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
 3+ years of professional experience building and shipping web applications.
 Frontend: Proficiency in TypeScript and a modern framework such as React.
 Backend: Proficiency in Python and experience building APIs (FastAPI, Django, or similar).
 Databases: Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and with data modeling.
 Experience building products on top of machine learning models or LLM APIs.
 Software Fundamentals: Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, testing, and version control (Git).
 
 
 Preferred Qualifications
 PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with an emphasis on RF/microwave integrated circuit design.
 Experience building technical or engineering software, such as CAD, simulation, or data analysis tools.
 Data visualization experience (D3, Plotly, WebGL).
 Experience with long-running job systems, queues, and real-time status updates.
 Experience with enterprise authentication (SSO, SAML) and multi-tenant architecture.
 Experience building agent-based or LLM-driven user experiences.
 Familiarity with chip design formats (GDSII, SPICE netlists, Touchstone) or an interest in learning RF concepts.
 Benefits 
 Competitive Salary and Equity Package
 Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
 401(k) Retirement Plan
 Paid Time Off (PTO) and Sick Leave
 
 DISCLOSURE
 Falcomm is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Falcomm is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.
 Applicants wishing to view a copy of Falcomm’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should notify Falcomm.
 To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
